text: My experience has been beyond horrible here. They were so keen to get me in as I got 16 composite veneers. While I was there they said I need to leave for 20 minutes while department came and did a check through the clinic. A hour and a half later I come back and they continue. They took 4 hours longer than they said they had people waiting for over a hour so the dentist was rushing my bottom teeth. I had to keep asking them to change the look and the floss wasn’t going between each took it kept breaking. We got to a shape I was happy with but on the first initial check up they said I need x2 root canals and multiple fillings. I didn’t proceed with this as I will back in my country. They did a clean on the initial check up. But after they finished my veneers one of my fillings I had previously fell out a few days after which is now extremely painful and it never was beforehand. x2 of my bottom veneers have chipped within the first month. The hole in my tooth where the filling came out of is now extremely painful and I have sensitive nerves on my bottom veneers which hasn’t gone down. I have approached them and they don’t want to take any ownership or accountability and don’t care. I’m so disappointed as this was meant to be a special thing I did for myself and now I’m left spending thousands more then needed to fix everything they have done. DEFINITELY DONT GO TO CUBE DENTAL!
They were fully booked, but I wrote them a message and they immediately gave me the best date. The treatment was great. The staff was very friendly. I'm glad I visited them

Absolutely amazing job, super perfectionist — HIGHLY skilled doctor, I recommend this place for everyone. This is the best dental experience I have ever had - like EVER, in 30 years.

The staff are the cutest most caring and sweet people, the place is hyper clean - you can’t even wear shoes inside - it’s just an all around great experience; never thought I would say that about a dental clinic or anything related, but I almost wanna come back just to say hi to everyone.
